column5: Look: saturated 90s arcade at sunset. Purple-to-orange sky with a huge low sun at the end of the street, flat-shaded low-poly blocks, palm trees, red-and-white striped kerbs, neon sign strips, long shadows. Palette roles: white and red ambulance (player), red fire engine and dark police cruiser (rivals), yellow "IT" marker (threat), dark violet road, teal ground. Signature: the "IT" vehicle trails a flapping hospital gown and a glowing marker you can see across the district. Every figure drawn, no emoji, no plain circles.
